ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the rider's threat toward the driver; preserve the chat log; contact the driver with welfare and reporting guidance (RydeHELP), and consider account action against the rider under the Code of Conduct.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen: the dispute type is safety and the record contains a threat. Chat #2 at 18:24, sent by the rider, reads "Say that again and I will punch you." [F4] in response to the driver's "Please do not smoke in the car." [F3], and the driver's statement corroborates it verbatim with the same account of events [F6]. This is a threat of physical violence aimed at the driver — "abuse of any kind" / "threats and intimidation" under Ryde's Code of Conduct — so SAFE-1 applies and no automatic ruling is made; the case goes to a human reviewer with a factual summary. The chat record is complete and every message is timestamped [F5], so the threat is not an artefact of a missing or untimed record. Safety basis is best treated as confirmed: an explicit conditional threat to punch, in the rider's own message, is not ambiguous. Note for completeness that no routing issue exists (actual 8.5 km equals optimal 8.5 km, -1% [F1]; duration 13.2 min vs 16.3 min estimated [F2]), so no refund or fee question arises — the escalation is purely safety-driven. No clause outside SAFE-1 is applied: RD-1/RD-2 find no off-route segment, and the FARE/NS branches are not in issue. Profiles [F7][F8] show no prior disputes on either side and are not used to decide anything.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety incident: rider made an explicit threat of violence ("I will punch you") toward the driver in the in-app chat, falling under SAFE-1 (abuse / threats and intimidation). Automatic adjudication withheld; human review required, with account-review consideration for the rider.
safety_basis: Rider chat #2 [F4]: "Say that again and I will punch you." — threat of physical violence aimed at the driver, corroborated by driver statement [F6]; dispute type is safety.
